quakes.label: Earthquakes
quakes.says: Feed page: "Updated every minute." Response headers: cache-control max-age=60.
quakes.licence: USGS Copyrights and Credits page: "USGS-authored or produced data and information are considered to be in the U.S. Public Domain"; credit is requested.

events.label: Storms, floods, fires and volcanoes
events.source: GDACS (Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System)
events.says: Feed reference page: its popular feeds are "updated every 6 minutes". The cadence of the API we call is not stated on the page.
events.licence: Terms of use page: a disclaimer only (results are model output, "may require further validation", "should not be used for decision making" alone). A reuse licence is not stated on the page.

aurora.label: Aurora forecast
aurora.says: Product page: "a 30 to 90 minute forecast". The refresh interval is not stated on the page; response headers: cache-control max-age=60.
aurora.licence: Not stated on the pages read.
aurora.credit: Aurora: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center

kp.label: Geomagnetic activity (Kp)
kp.says: The refresh interval is not stated on the page; response headers: cache-control max-age=60.
kp.licence: Not stated on the pages read.
kp.credit: Kp: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center

clouds.label: Cloud forecast
clouds.says: Terms: "don't repeat requests until the time indicated in the Expires response header" and use If-Modified-Since. Measured: Expires about 30 minutes after the request.
clouds.licence: Terms: attribution required as in CC BY 4.0; requests must identify the application in the User-Agent; browsers "should not contact the API directly".

planes.label: Aircraft
planes.says: Refresh interval and rate limits are not stated on the pages read.
planes.licence: Pages read: "License: ODbL 1.0". Its attribution and share-alike conditions need reading before a public launch.

satellites.label: Satellite orbits
satellites.says: Usage policy: "For GP data, updates are once every 2 hours." Stop at the first non-200 answer and tell a human; repeating gets the address firewalled.
satellites.licence: Usage policy page read; it asks users to follow it and to cache. No licence text on that page.
satellites.note: 206 exact orbits, 162 launched in the last 30 days, median element age 15.1 h

catalogue.label: Satellite catalogue
catalogue.says: The catalogue refresh interval is not stated on the pages read. Larger lists are rate limited, so this is fetched once a day.
catalogue.licence: Usage policy page read; no licence text on that page.

static.label: Stars and constellation lines
static.note: Fixed catalogue packed at build time (Hipparcos based). Non-commercial licence, see docs/feature-sources.md.

static.label: Coastlines
static.note: Natural Earth outlines via world-atlas, packed at build time.

static.label: Earth, Moon and cloud images
static.note: Packed at build time. The cloud image is a daily NASA GIBS composite from the build day and is not refreshed by this pipeline yet.

static.label: Flight routes and airlines
static.note: Looked up once at build time from adsb.lol and OpenFlights. The route endpoint is marked deprecated, so this is not refreshed.

static.label: Shaking maps and population exposure
static.note: Fetched once at build time for the largest quakes from USGS ShakeMap and PAGER. New quakes show no shaking map until this is made live.
